name: @tekad/source
description: TEKAD — an Angular-22-first open-source UI ecosystem. Workspace root; not published.

scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run verify:no-webpack-builder && pnpm run verify:deps && pnpm run verify:entrypoints && pnpm run verify:aria && pnpm run verify:forms-contracts && pnpm run verify:contrast && pnpm run verify:gates && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.verify:gates: node tools/verify-no-webpack-builder.test.mjs && node tools/verify-dependency-policy.test.mjs && node tools/verify-licences.test.mjs && node tools/verify-audit.test.mjs && node tools/verify-package-format.test.mjs && node tools/verify-entrypoint-boundaries.test.mjs && node tools/verify-reactive-rules.test.mjs && node tools/lib/color.test.mjs && node tools/verify-contrast.test.mjs && node tools/verify-forms-contracts.test.mjs && node tools/verify-boundaries.test.mjs
scripts.verify:licences: pnpm licenses list --prod --json > .nx/lic-prod.json && pnpm licenses list --json > .nx/lic-all.json && node tools/verify-licences.mjs .nx/lic-prod.json .nx/lic-all.json
scripts.verify:audit: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high --json > .nx/audit-prod.json || true; pnpm audit --audit-level=high --json > .nx/audit-all.json || true; node tools/verify-audit.mjs .nx/audit-prod.json .nx/audit-all.json
